reply_text:
I told Dana the seat count is **185**, in a reply in their direct message.

- **Source:** On 20 Aug 2025 Dana wrote in #north-team that Amendment No. 1 took Quarrendon Freight Lines to 180 seats. At 09:17, two minutes later, they corrected it to 185. Dana is a member of that channel, so they can see this themselves. A seat count is an operational fact rather than a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
- **Not checked against the contract:** the signed amendment isn't in any file I can see, so the 185 comes only from that chat. I suggested Dana check it against the signed copy, which June Osei-Lark has.
